name: BugX
name_zh: BugX 代码审查与智能测试
description: Autonomous code review and testing agent. Catches hidden deep bugs for developers, automates black-box, functional, and performance testing for QA, and ensures rock-solid software delivery.
description_zh: BugX 是一个具备自主代码审查与测试能力的智能体，严把代码交付关：它帮助开发人员在写完代码后自动排查隐藏的深层 Bug，减少反复排错与返工；帮助测试人员自动化运行黑盒测试、功能验证与性能测试，自动覆盖手工盲测难以覆盖的极端场景；确保代码功能符合要求、具备良好的健壮性和稳定性。让开发和测试在繁琐的工作中解放双手，大幅提高工作效率、全面提升代码质量、显著降低后期维护成本，实现科技服务于人。
description_en: Autonomous code review and testing agent. Catches hidden deep bugs for developers, automates black-box, functional, and performance testing for QA, and ensures rock-solid software delivery.
examples_zh: 运行代码审查，排查深层 Bug 与性能隐患
自动化运行功能验证与黑盒测试
examples_en: Run code review to uncover deep bugs and performance bottlenecks
Automate functional verification and black-box testing
